title: Beyond Surface Judgments: Human-Grounded Risk Evaluation of LLM-Generated Disinformation
reasoning: The paper focuses on auditing LLM judges against human responses regarding the credibility and shareability of disinformation. While it includes a specific example of fake news involving a religious figure (the Pope), it does not evaluate religious beliefs, morals, or ethical systems as a core component; rather, it uses various public-issue topics to test for alignment between human and model judgments.
